title: Exact individual Rudin--Shapiro fourth moments and defect coefficient

individual_moment.orthogonality: The integral vanishes because P_n and z^(v_n)Q_n have disjoint Fourier supports, so the two individual fourth moments are equal for every n>=1.
individual_moment.closed_form: For either R_n=P_n or Q_n, int|R_n|^4=d_n^2[4/3-(1/3)(-1/2)^n].
individual_moment.cubic_defect: At n=3r the K1647 field has D_(M,N)=-[1+(1/2)(-1/8)^r]A_N^4d_N^2, so its defect coefficient tends to -1.
individual_moment.scope_guard: This sharpens the negative term only. It does not compare the posterior-score residual, prove descent, or identify the unrestricted coefficient.
